purpose: Reduce hard blocking of benign safety, governance, RAG analysis, OCR privacy, and plugin audit content.

recovery_profiles.notes: XSTest / StrongREJECT style benign safety questions should not be hard-blocked.
RAG documents may quote unsafe text for defensive analysis; keep it as evidence, not instruction.
OCR privacy education posters should be allowed while preserving OCR evidence boundaries.
Plugin manifest review is a defensive audit task, not tool misuse by itself.
Governance/security document lookup should be allowed unless it asks for operational abuse.

claim_boundary: Recovery profiles reduce hard blocks; they do not erase risk findings when active attack intent or tool side effects are present.
